lines.name: CARD
lines.text:
Saturday. 11:40 AM. Biscayne Card Room, off the causeway.
Carpet from 1994. Coffee from this morning, maybe.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Somebody bought me a seat. The Biscayne Championship.

lines.name: MILES
lines.subject: gnomey
lines.text: Free seat? Lucky you. Table nine, seat four. Cards in the air at noon.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: A hundred and eighteen players. Two hundred and fifty dollars a seat. You paid nothing, and your hands are shaking anyway.

directions.text: the clatter of chips like rain on a tin roof, a floor call far off
